title: Freeze regression inputs
responsibility: Keep test inputs fixed between the failing-test commit and its fix.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Repository-relative test, configuration, source or metadata path.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Disposable or project Git checkout containing committed source.

inputs.name: commit
inputs.description: Actual immutable Git commit to inspect.

inputs.name: tests
inputs.description: Selected tracked test files; product source cannot be disguised as a test.

inputs.name: red
inputs.description: The original failed checkpoint and its frozen file and authored expectation identities.

outputs.name: testPath
outputs.description: Identifies standard tests, fixtures and scenario declarations.

outputs.name: metadata
outputs.description: Identifies loop traces and Markdown documentation.

outputs.name: regressionFiles
outputs.description: Actual Git file blobs plus separate typed authored expectation digests and source provenance.

outputs.name: regressionFixCommit
outputs.description: Admits only a separate product repair with unchanged executable tests and authored expectations.

outputs.name: regressionTestCommit
outputs.description: Admits strengthened test code or authored expectations and rejects product changes.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Explains untracked or product test inputs, changed frozen inputs and invalid checkpoint boundaries.
